summary: Iteration 14 — retest of Batch B fixes. All 3 bugs from iter13 confirmed FIXED. iter13 test suite now 8/8 PASSED (was 7/8). Full regression iter10+iter11+iter12+iter13 = 57/57 PASSED. Verified: (1) POST /api/self-order/{id}/accept now accepts status='Pesanan Diterima' (server.py:1218 allow-list expanded) — kasir successfully accepts newly-created self-orders, sale created with variant.price authoritative (server ignored client-sent wrong_price=1.0 and used variant.price*qty), notes 'extra hot please' persisted in sale.lines[0].notes, variant_id + variant_name preserved. (2) SelfOrderInput.customer_phone now persisted to mjd_self_orders.customer_phone column — verified directly via DB query: TEST_Phone_User row has customer_phone='6281234567890', TEST_Variant_User row has '628999'. (3) GET /api/notifications capped to <=10 items after sort+truncate — test_max_items_bound updated from <=25 to <=10 and passes.

minor.issue: created_at for 'stock' items still set to request-time now() rather than a real event time; stock notifications always outrank shift/order items in sort. Not blocking, but sort order is not semantically meaningful.
unread_count == len(items); no read-state persistence so frontend badge cannot decrement across polls.
customer_phone is persisted but not returned in the public status endpoint response — consider echoing it back for customer confirmation UX.

action_items: OPTIONAL: use product.updated_at (or last_restock_at) for stock notification created_at so ordering is meaningful.
OPTIONAL: implement read-state persistence for notifications so unread_count is accurate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1218 fix looks correct: `if order.status not in ('Menunggu kasir','Menunggu konfirmasi','Pesanan Diterima')`. Consider removing the deprecated 'Menunggu konfirmasi' entry if no code path still emits it.
server.py:1167 correctly forwards customer_phone into the SelfOrder ORM object; verified persisted end-to-end.
Notification truncation to top-10 after global sort now respects spec.
server.py is now ~2032 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline; suggest splitting routers/{notifications,self_order,dashboard}.py.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed self-orders (11 rows) were created during testing and DELETED from mjd_self_orders after verification. DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch B fixes are green. All three iter13 blockers resolved. If new tests are added, note that pytest.ini enables xdist loadscope automatically. Kasir must have an open shift at outlet-sudirman; the kasir_sess fixture opens one if none exists. The /api/self-order/{id}/status endpoint still does NOT echo customer_phone — if a test wants to verify phone persistence via API only, it currently must go through admin/DB path; iter14 verified via direct SQL on mjd_self_orders.
rca of the issue: All three iter13 bugs confirmed fixed by main agent: (a) server.py:1218 accept guard extended to include 'Pesanan Diterima' — verified by successfully accepting a newly-created self-order end-to-end and receiving a valid sale response.
